chapter: The Grid (levels 71-80, the neon wireframe world of mathematical solids) - regenerated on the desert's ember model (the owner, 2026-10-11, #824): a lead line the ear can follow, its identity in the mid range, the drive carried by arrangement rather than by noise and sub bass; the family's electronic dance root kept
purpose: Master of Game/Music/pulse-trance.ogg: written from this file by Tools/MusicBake --tracks --masters <this folder>, brought to the themes' loudness, peaks held under full scale, Ogg Vorbis. The master stays outside the repository (C:/Users/panrd/AI/output/masters-824-chosen on the desktop, with its .raw.wav; every candidate in masters-824); this sidecar is committed beside the .ogg.
generator: ACE-Step 1.5 (acestep.cpp v0.0.5), local, AMD RX 6900 XT via Vulkan -- batch-pulse.ps1 -> generate-music.ps1 -Loop -NoCotCaption
format: 48000 Hz, 32-bit float PCM, stereo -- 48 kHz is the model's fixed native rate

request.caption: Melodic trance instrumental for a neon wireframe world of glowing geometric shapes: a memorable, singing analog synth lead melody of many notes you can hum, warm and round, loud and upfront in the mid range, a warm low plucked synth arpeggio rolling beneath it, a tight four-on-the-floor kick, a deep round snare and toms with a dark ride cymbal playing throughout from the first bar to the last, a warm rolling off-beat bass in the mid range, warm string-synth chords, a piano doubling the melody in the second half, the full groove never stopping, glowing and hopeful, warm mid-forward mix, modern polished production, wide stereo mix with instruments panned left and right, stereo delays, spacious reverb, no vocals

chosen.why: inside ember on every column: 9.5 % in 200 Hz-2 kHz (old 4.3 %; ember's lowest is 9.5 %), 8.4 % in 300 Hz-4 kHz, 2.0 % above 6 kHz (old 5.8 %), tonal mid 75 % (old 39 %), 3.38 held-note changes/s (old 2.59), a 42 s loop in time (context 0.67, crossfade r 0.91 against 0.80, spectrum cos 0.70), no hole, wrap step -3.0 dB (p48). Round 1's uplifting brief left holes in all three and up to 5.6 % above 6 kHz; round 2 asked a warm round lead, no breakdown and no supersaw
chosen.how: every candidate measured with Tools/Generation/measure-music.py --reference ember in one run (band shares, tonal mid, mid flatness, held-note changes, tempo wander, wrap step) beside the loop cut's own check, the hole share (the loop more than 10 dB under its loud level), the breakdown dip and the stereo correlation; a seam below its own rhythm, a hole over 15 %, a 2 s dropout more than 20 dB down, a wrap step of 10 dB or more or at or above p97 of the loop's own steps, a seam spectrum cosine under 0.3 or a loop under 30 s ruled a candidate out; the table is on #824
